# math

> Math: integer functions, fixed-point decimals, big integers and random numbers.

[source](../../registry/math.pkg) · truck

```
use std
use math

print math_gcd(84, 36)                       // 12
print math_is_prime(2147483647)              // true
print fx_str(fx_div(fx(22), fx(7)))          // 3.142857
print big_str(big_pow(big_new(3), 50))       // 717897987691852588770249
rand_seed(7)
print rand_range(1, 6)
```

| package | gives |
|---|---|
| `math/int` | `math_abs`, `math_min`, `math_max`, `math_clamp`, `math_gcd`, `math_pow`, `math_pow_mod`, `math_isqrt`, `math_ilog2`, `math_is_prime`, `math_floor_div`, checked `+ - *`, ... |
| `math/fixed` | decimals with six places in an `int`: `fx`, `fx_mul`, `fx_div`, `fx_sqrt`, `fx_parse`, `fx_str`, ... |
| `math/big` | integers of any size: `big_new`, `big_parse`, `big_add`, `big_mul`, `big_div`, `big_pow`, `big_str`, ... |
| `math/rand` | a seedable generator: `rand_seed`, `rand_int`, `rand_range`, `rand_shuffle`, ... |

Packenger has no floating point; fixed-point decimals cover most of
what it would be used for, exactly and the same on every backend.

## Packages

| package | summary |
|---|---|
| [math/int](math/int.md) | Integer math: abs, min, max, clamp, gcd, powers, roots, logs, primes, floor division and checked arithmetic. |
| [math/fixed](math/fixed.md) | Fixed-point decimals: numbers with six decimal places, kept in an int as millionths. |
| [math/big](math/big.md) | Big integers: whole numbers of any size, for when 64 bits aren't enough. |
| [math/rand](math/rand.md) | Random numbers: a seedable generator (xorshift64*) for games, shuffles and tests. Not for secrets. |
